Green will cover Blue on the second.|[[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]]|<ref name="ANH" /><ref name="ANHnote">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]] refers to [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] as "Red Squadron" and to [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] as "Blue Squadron".</ref>}}
'''Yellow Squadron''' was the name of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==History==
Yellow Squadron covered for [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ANH" /><ref name="ANHnote" />
